title: FEEL built-in function signatures
description: Every FEEL built-in BPMN Kit implements, with its parameter names per signature. Implementations stay in code; this is the name, arity and named-argument table both sides share.

signatures.description: Parameter names in declaration order, one list per accepted signature.

variadic.description: DMN also defines it over a bare argument list (max(1,2,3) means max([1,2,3])); its arity is not checked.
